style.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF for packshots, soft cream #FBF3E4 and warm stone-grey plazas for info and scene shots, marigold #F2A63C reserved for accents and CTA

style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm playful kids-streetwear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white background #FFFFFF, soft cream #FBF3E4, charcoal text #2E2E2E and one sunny marigold accent #F2A63C; bright airy daylight studio lighting with front-left key and soft contact shadows; modern rounded sans-serif; simple flat marigold accent chips with thin-line icons; clean lifestyle childrenswear photography mixed with minimal infographic panels; stable slight 3/4 hero product angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle for the garment across the set, garment always the clear subject
